headline: Pakistan's fodder exports fell 49 percent to $15.5 million in July-September 2026 from $30.1 million in the previous quarter as the US-Iran war raised freight costs, and some Sindh farmers are uprooting Rhodes grass to plant wheat, Arab News reports.

card.desc: Kisan Rhodes grass ukhaar kar gandum laga rahe hain.

caption:
Chara exports mein 49% kami!
Arab News ke mutabiq July-September 2026 mein Pakistan ki chara (fodder) exports 49% gir kar $15.5 million reh gayin, jo pichli quarter mein $30.1 million thin. Sindh mein kuch kisan Rhodes grass ukhaar kar gandum laga rahe hain, kyun ke rate Rs27,000-Rs30,000 per ton hai jo pichle saal Rs56,000 tha.
Kya kisanon ko madad milni chahiye? Comment mein batayein 👇
